description: For house cleaning, this inspection checklist records scheduled task set, rotation items, customer exceptions, team assignment, products, time window, and add-on approval. Its supporting evidence includes arrival exceptions, completed-zone checks, quality observations, supply exceptions, photos, and customer messages.

items: Entry, living areas, and reachable surfaces match the agreed task list

Bathrooms, mirrors, fixtures, and floors are complete
Bedrooms and requested rotation items are complete
Trash, supplies, fragile items, pets, keys, and access are accounted for
Missed areas, damage concerns, add-ons, and customer notes are recorded

title: House Cleaning Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during recurring house-cleaning service record when the house cleaning record must identify account, service zone, room sequence, surface restrictions, pets, keys or codes, preferences, and recurring notes. Complete the applicable handoff for quality review, secured-property confirmation, missed-task recovery, preference update, and next-service handoff.
